warnings: This page is an index of camps and clinics on the college athletics site. It has no details of its own and only links to a single clinic flyer, and that link was not available.

The heading says '2026-27', but the one program listed is a '2026' Baseball College Prospect Clinic, updated Sept. 11, 2026. It may be a fall 2026 clinic that is already past or about to happen, not a summer 2027 camp.
The address comes from the athletics website footer. The page does not say this is where the clinic takes place.
The only email on the page (sgibbons@ric.edu) is for website accessibility problems, not camp questions, so it was not recorded.
